purpose: Representative accuracy/latency workflow across fixed feature recipes; not FI-2010 optimization

ridge.scaling: eligible-training standard deviations, folded into FP64 affine coefficients
ridge.selection: maximum validation macro-F1, first candidate on ties

mean5.definition: mean of current plus four previous vectors

current_mean5.location: v2, section 4.1, Figure 1; last plus mean

concat5.definition: five supplied vectors, current to oldest
concat5.location: v2, section 4.1, Figure 1; concat; ordering explicitly fixed here
